facts.fact: Per a third-party source (The Drum, Merkle article), over 80% of spending on retail media networks comes from net-new budget sources rather than reallocated existing advertising budgets.
According to StackAdapt's article, an ad server determines the optimal placement of ads so they reach the intended audience.
facts.quote: Moreover, an ad server determines the optimal placement of ads, so they reach the intended audience.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that the future of travel media is headed toward greater integration and convergence with adtech and martech.
facts.quote: The future of travel media is headed towards greater integration and convergence with advertising technology (adtech) and marketing technology (martech).

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that major airlines must ensure any media content aligns with their established brand values, including controlling the type of ads shown and the partners they work with.
facts.quote: Major airlines have spent decades building their brand reputation and must ensure that any media content aligns with their established brand values.
